id.description:
A single activity-log entry, mirroring App\Http\Resources\ActivityResource
(spatie/laravel-activitylog). Shared by the audit log and the per-record
history endpoints.

Response and request shapes for patient assistance, its lifecycle logs and
released-aid report snapshots.

Case and case-watcher response/request shapes, mirroring
App\Http\Resources\{CaseModel,CaseWatcher}Resource and the case form requests.

transaction_id.description: HIS encounter (psPatRegisters PK) this case was opened for.

transaction_type.description: Encounter transaction-type label, snapshotted at open.

admission_type.description: Required unless transaction_id is given, from which it is snapshotted.

transaction_id.description: HIS encounter (psPatRegisters PK) to open the case for.

CaseWatcherStoreRequest.description: Either link an existing patient_watcher_id or supply an inline person (name + relationship code).

relationship.description: Watcher relationship type code. Required without patient_watcher_id.

WatcherStatus.description: The watcher-requirement status banner for a case.

waiver.description: The filed-waiver detail, or null when the case has no explicit waiver (a legacy-exempt case is waived but carries no waiver record).

waived_by.description: Resolved name of the section head who filed the waiver.

CaseActivity.description: A case activity-timeline entry (assignment, transfer, etc.).

id.description:
Response and request shapes for the case clinical records: assessments and
their expenses, the social case study, diagnostics and reports, interventions
and progress notes.

SocialCaseRequest.description: Every narrative field is optional; the report is written over time.

message.description:
Shared schema components: the pagination envelope and the validation-error
body. Concrete resource collections reference PaginationMeta / PaginationLinks
alongside their own `data` array.

first_name: The first name field is required.

PaginationLinks.description: The `links` block of a paginated collection.

PaginationMeta.description: The `meta` block of a paginated collection.

HospitalPatient.description: A patient record from the hospital information system.

id.description:
Response shapes for the read-only hospital information system (HIS) lookups,
mirroring App\Http\Resources\{HospitalPatient,PatientTransaction,PatientGuarantor}Resource.
The HIS schema is translated, so unknown columns are omitted rather than guessed.

personal_data.description: Mapped personal-data block (present on the aggregate show only).

transactions.description: Present on the aggregate show only.

PatientGuarantor.description: A guarantor ledger row from the HIS.

id.description:
Response and request shapes for the unified intake sheet, mirroring
App\Http\Resources\UnifiedIntakeSheetResource and StoreUnifiedIntakeSheetRequest.

IntakeSheetRequest.description: The unified intake payload: header, patient (reuse patient_id OR create a new patient object), optional sub-records, case (case_id OR new case), optional assessment, recommended assistances and expenses. See StoreUnifiedIntakeSheetRequest for the full field set.

id.description:
Response and request shapes for the patient sub-records: IDs, family members,
watchers, caretakers, documents and merge records.

target_id.description: The surviving patient the source merges into.

id.description:
Response body for a patient, mirroring App\Http\Resources\PatientResource.
The `*_count` and relation fields only appear when eager-loaded (show/profile).

Response shapes for the read-only reference lookups (sectors, assistant types,
intervention types, guarantors, watcher relationship types) and the MSWD
classification matrix.

MswdClassificationMatrix.description: A row of the MSWD socioeconomic classification matrix.

User.description: A system user (mirrored from the HR employee directory).

id.description:
User, role and permission response shapes, plus the login request/response,
mirroring App\Http\Resources\{User,Role,Permission}Resource and LoginController.

LoginResponse.description: The authenticated user plus the issued bearer token.

roles.description: The complete set of role names for the user.

Unauthenticated.description: No valid Sanctum token was supplied.

message.description:
Shared response components referenced across every endpoint.

Reference them from operations as, e.g.:
  #[OA\Response(response: 401, ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthenticated')]

Forbidden.description: The token is valid but lacks the required permission.

NotFound.description: The requested resource does not exist.

NoContent.description: The action succeeded and returned no body.

search.name: search
search.description: Free-text search over the repository-defined searchable columns.

sort.name: sort
sort.description: Column to sort by (must be sortable for the resource).

sanctum.description: Sanctum personal access token, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
